inference.calloutDesc: Correct anything the extraction got wrong here — add a capability it missed or remove one that doesn't apply. It won't change your uploaded YAML, but when you continue to Results the findings, scores and counts are recomputed from your edits. Security controls aren't part of this view: they're not in the YAML, they're what the analysis recommends, so you'll find them in Results.
